_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Complacency with no vol/funding/momentum breaker; base rate and diverging 2019 top factors make HOLD the graded call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative is flow description only and silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54, 30d momentum stays <65, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks <39 on vol spike, or F&G and momentum both clear 62 with funding lifting
